accountName.title: Account Name
accountName.description: Account name to resolve to AccountId for the Case. IMPORTANT: When the user wants to add or update the account on a case (e.g., "update the account to Acme Corp"), use this parameter with the account name. Do NOT put AccountId in fieldDataJson - use this parameter instead. The system will automatically resolve the account name to an Account ID.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: For create/update: Set to false to preview only. For delete: Set to true to actually delete.

contactNameOrEmail.title: Contact Name or Email
contactNameOrEmail.description: Contact name or email to resolve to ContactId for the Case. IMPORTANT: When the user wants to add or update the contact on a case (e.g., "add the contact as John Smith" or "update the contact to jane@example.com"), use this parameter with the contact name or email. Do NOT put ContactId in fieldDataJson - use this parameter instead. The system will automatically resolve the contact name/email to a Contact ID. If multiple contacts match, the system will return candidates for user clarification.

fieldDataJson.title: Field Data JSON
fieldDataJson.description: JSON string containing Case field data. For create: {"Subject":"Support Request","Status":"New"}. For update: {"Status":"Closed","Priority":"High"}. For bulk: [{"Subject":"Request 1"},{"Subject":"Request 2"}]. IMPORTANT: For picklist fields (Status, Priority, Type, Origin, etc.), query availableFieldsJson from a previous read operation to see valid values. Do NOT ask the user for picklist options - query availableFieldsJson to get them automatically. If the user wants to update the Contact or Account on the case, use the contactNameOrEmail or accountName parameters instead of putting ContactId or AccountId in fieldDataJson.

filtersJson.title: Filters JSON
filtersJson.description: JSON string of exact-match filters for find operations. IMPORTANT: If the user wants to find a case but hasn't provided specific filters, ask them for details like case number, account name, or status BEFORE calling this action. Do not call find operation without a searchTerm or filtersJson.

includeEmailSummary.title: Include Email Summary
includeEmailSummary.description: Set to true to include a summary of related email messages when reading or finding a case. When true, the response will include emailSummaryJson with the most recent 10 emails on the case, along with caseSummaryData for a comprehensive briefing. Use this when user asks to "summarize", "catch me up", "what has been discussed", "email history", or wants context on case communications.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: Explicit operation: "create", "read", "update", "delete", "find", or "summarize". If not specified, inferred from context. SUMMARIZE: Use when user asks to "summarize this case", "catch me up on this ticket", "what has been discussed", "show me the email history", or wants a TL;DR of a case with its email communications.

recordId.title: Record ID
recordId.description: The Salesforce record ID of the Case. Required for read/update/delete/summarize. Format: 18-character ID like "500xx000003DGbYAAW".

searchLimit.title: Search Limit
searchLimit.description: Maximum number of records to return for find operations (default: 5, max: 20).

searchTerm.title: Search Term
searchTerm.description: Text to search for in Case fields (Subject, CaseNumber, Account Name, etc.). Used for find and summarize operations. For SUMMARIZE: If recordId is not provided, the system will search for a matching case using this term. Examples: "00001182", "University Medical", "billing issue".
